name: sharg
description: Sharg is a C++20 header-only library that simplifies the creation of command-line interfaces by mapping inputs directly to variables. Use when user asks to parse command-line arguments, define options and flags, or generate help menus and documentation for C++ applications.
overview: Sharg is a C++20 header-only library designed to simplify the creation of robust command-line interfaces (CLIs). It eliminates the boilerplate associated with manual `argc` and `argv` parsing by mapping command-line inputs directly to C++ variables. Beyond simple parsing, it automatically generates professional help menus, handles versioning, and supports advanced features like subcommands and documentation export.
